infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The teleprompter shows a live camera preview so you can read your script and frame yourself while recording.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone records your audio and lets the teleprompter follow along as you speak.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Speech recognition auto-scrolls the script to follow the words you speak.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Saves your finished recordings to your photo library.
